about: Ours (docs/adr/0025-achievements.md): the achievements' names, descriptions and pictures. The server (shards-server util/achievements.kod) only says which ids (blakston.khd ACH_*; a boss's is its guild trophy's) are earned and when. sprite is the .bgf its monster draws (none: the game's logo); title is the title it adds to the character's look.
